senses.gloss: सुलभ- + अवकाश सुलभ- + अवकाश, adj. f. शा, getting easily the opportunity (of appearing), Śāk. d. 191.
शूलोद्यतकर शूलोद्यतकर, i. e. शूल-उद्यत- (vb. यम्), adj. with a spear in his uplifted hand.

सु- + लक्षण सु- + लक्षण,
 I. adj. having auspicious marks, Rām. 3, 49, 57.
 II. n. determining.
 III. f. णा, a proper name.
सु- + ललित सु- + ललित, adj. 1. sporting. 2. pleased, very delicate, Hit. 37, 4, M.M. 3. very beautiful, Ṛt. 1, 28; Bhartṛ. 3, 28. ˚तम्, adv. delightedly, easily.

† शुल्क् शुल्क्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To create.
 2. To gain.
 3. To abandon.
 4. To speak (cf. श्वल्क्).

शुल्क शुल्क, m. and n.
 1. Toll, tax, duty, Man. 10, 120.
 2. Money given at the purchase of anything, to ratify the bargain.
 3. Money given to the parents of the bride, originally as purchase-price, cf. MBh. 13, 2422, sqq. and 4530; Man. 3, 51.
 4. A nuptial present, Man. 9, 93.
 5. The profits of household labour, care of milch cattle, etc., when considered as the legal property of the wife.
 6. Price, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 15.
 --Comp.

शुल्व शुल्व, n.
 1. Copper.
 2. A rope.
 3. Institute, law.
 4. A sacrificial observance.
 5. A quantity of water.

† शूल् शूल्, i. 1 (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par.
 1. To be sick.
 2. To make a loud noise.
 3. To impale.

शूल शूल (cf. शो),
 I. m. and n.
 1. A pike, a dart, a weapon, Sund. 1, 24; Rām. 5, 53, 53.
 2. An iron pin or spit.
 3. A banner.
 4. Sharp pain, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 19; Lass. 31, 18; especially in the belly, as colic, Rājat. 5, 53.
 5. Death.
 II. f. ला.
 1. A stake for impaling criminals, Pañc. 238, 1.
 2. A whore.
 --Comp.
शूलक शूल + क, m. A restive horse.

शूलिक शूलिक, i. e. शूल + इक,
 I. adj. Roasted on a spit (ŚKD.).
 II. m. A hare.

शूलिन् शूलिन्, i. e. शूल + इन्,
 I. adj. Suffering sharp pain.
 II. m.
 1. A spearman.
 2. A stake-bearer.
 3. Śiva, Bhartṛ. 2, 52.
 --Comp.

शूल्य शूल्य, i. e. शूला̆ + य,
 I. adj.
 1. Roasted on a spit, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 9.
 2. Deserving impalement.
 II. n. Roasted meat.

सुलभ सु-लभ् + अ, adj.
 1. Of easy acquisition, easy to be found, Pañc. ii. d. 171; easy to be got, Pañc. iii. d. 262; easy to be perceived, Vikr. d. 26.
 2. Easy to be effected.
 3. Easy.
 --Comp.
शुल्क- + स्थान शुल्क- + स्थान, n. any object of toll or duty, Man. 8, 398.
शूल- + हस्त शूल- + हस्त, adj. armed with a lance, Sund. 1, 14.
शूल-मुद्गर- + हस्त शूल-मुद्गर- + हस्त, adj. armed with clubs and lances, Sund. 2, 3.
